title: Minimum Number of Flips to Convert Binary Matrix to Zero Matrix
description: Find the minimum number of flips (flipping a cell and its 4 neighbors) to turn all matrix cells to 0 using BFS.

2. visited = {initial_state}
3. steps = 0
4. while queue:
